user.title: Connect ToHuus Hub
user.description: In ToHuus Hub open Settings › Access & AI › New access, choose "Home Assistant" and copy the token. Enter the address you open ToHuus Hub with.

data_description.token: Starts with sw_ – shown only once when you create it.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for self-signed certificates.

reauth_confirm.title: New access token
reauth_confirm.description: ToHuus Hub at {url} no longer accepts the token. Create a new "Home Assistant" access and paste it here.

reconfigure.title: Change ToHuus Hub address
reconfigure.description: Leave the token empty to keep the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach ToHuus Hub at this address.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Create a new "Home Assistant" access in ToHuus Hub.
error.not_supported: This ToHuus Hub is too old for the integration. Update ToHuus Hub first.

abort.already_configured: This ToHuus Hub is already set up.
abort.wrong_instance: That is a different ToHuus Hub than the one set up here.
